Amelia —

Appreciate the clear asks. I put together a short package and the mutual action plan (attached). High level summary here:

- Premium Response Pack (PRP): includes 24/7 P1 on-call routing, 4-hour P1 resolution SLA target (with escalation playbook), 1-hour P2 acknowledgement, and business-hours P3 support.
- Uptime tiers: 99.9% (Standard), 99.95% (Enhanced), 99.99% (Premium). Credits scale from 5% to 50% of monthly support fees depending on breach severity/recurrence.
- Pricing mechanics: unit token price unchanged; PRP billed as a monthly retainer + per-incident credits. For a 12-month committed spend at the "Enhanced" uptime tier we can offer a 20% discount on the monthly retainer. If FinPort commits to a 24-month term plus a committed spend band, that increases to 30%.

I've attached: Redwood_Pricing_Slate_v3.pdf (line-item pricing), SLA_ResponseMatrix_Granular.xlsx (SLO table + credit formulas), and a draft Mutual Action Plan (FinPort_MutualActionPlan.docx).

If you'd like, Ben can run an example TCO for your expected token mix. Monica will coordinate contract language with Legal for the credit triggers.

Next steps:
- I'll hop on a call Monday morning to walk the spreadsheet with engineering and procurement.
- If that works, we can route the redline to legal and provide a DocuSign envelope.

Thanks — talk Monday,
